card.name: Powers of ten in lab counts
card.fires_on: The digit or space right after "× 10" in scientific notation, such as cell counts (10^9/L) and vector genome doses. Also the F in a Fahrenheit temperature in parentheses.

modes.label: Exponent after × 10
modes.description: The exponent digit or gap following "× 10" in neutrophil counts or vector genome doses.
modes.example: Withhold TALVEY until absolute neutrophil count is 0.5 × 10<< >>9 /L or higher.

modes.label: Fahrenheit letter
modes.description: The F closing a Fahrenheit value after a Celsius room-temperature storage figure.

card.plain: It marks the exponent spot in numbers like 1 × 10^9/L, and the F in temperatures like 77°F.
